text:
lena: heads-up — seeing a memory growth in tokenizer v3.2.1 on eu1, causing ~5% client errors for long sequences. need an ad-hoc hotpatch outside the scheduled window. request: pin 3.2.1-hotfix -> 3.2.2 and rollout canary then 100%.

sam: oncall confirms spike at 09:14 UTC, errors from requests >1024 tokens. severity: increased client timeouts.

mike: infra check: can build and promote 3.2.2-hotfix. canary smoke locally passed. default window is closed but we can do limited rollout with rollback gates.

lena: annotated impact: product traffic eu-west1->eu1 reroute might increase risk; asking for expedited approvals from product + oncall + ops for out-of-window deploy.

paul: product here — impact OK for customers? we need a short release note and a rollback plan.

anya: SRE: agree to proceed if canary 1% for 10m then 10% for 10m with automatic rollback on 2% error delta. need deploy plan in thread.

mike: paste: ```
# deploy plan
deployctl promote --env eu1 --image redwood/tokenizer:3.2.2-hotfix --pin-version 3.2.2-hotfix
# canary config
--rollout 1%:10m -> 10%:10m -> 100%:gradual
# rollback on: error_rate +2% OR mem_growth > 200MB/instance
```

lena: tagging approvers: @ops-approver, @paul, @anya. can we get thumbs? :pray:

ops-approver: reviewing logs now. priority OK. approve for out-of-window deploy with oncall present. :thumbsup:

paul: +1 from product. will draft release note and post update to status page.

anya: +1 from SRE but will require live monitoring and the ability to abort. I'll be on standby.

sam: oncall approves, will run prechecks and hold rollback token.

deploy-bot: [DEPLOY REQUEST RECEIVED] user=mike env=eu1 image=redwood/tokenizer:3.2.2-hotfix pin=3.2.2-hotfix

deploy-bot: [CANARY START] rollout=1% duration=10m started_by=mike ts=2156789230

mike: canary logs look clean after 3m, mem stable.

lena: monitoring dashboards show no error delta at 6m. continuing.

deploy-bot: [CANARY ADVANCE] rollout=10% duration=10m ts=2156789350

anya: 10% smoke passed at 4m. holding until 10m then advance if stable.

paul: release note draft: "tokenizer: fix memory regression for long sequences (3.2.2-hotfix). rolling to eu1 now. customers may see brief reconnections." posting to status page.

deploy-bot: [ROLLING TO 100%] started ts=2156789460 -> expected completion 20m

sam: monitoring during rollout. if error_rate > +1.5% or mem_growth threshold hit, I'll abort and trigger rollback.

mike: ack. rollback command if needed: `deployctl rollback --env eu1 --to-version 3.2.1-hotfix`

deploy-bot: [ROLLBACK POLICY] automatic_abort_on=error_rate>2% OR mem_growth>200MB/instance

deploy-bot: [ROLLOUT COMPLETE] env=eu1 version=3.2.2-hotfix ts=2156789523 status=success

lena: great, thanks team. closing loop: pin applied, release note published, monitoring on. will follow up with a postmortem if anything pops up. :rocket:
